card.title: IPhone XR with half backlight on display

source.title: IPhone XR with half backlight on display

claims.statement: iPhone XR has two backlight circuits; a dark bottom corner points to one of them.

With only the battery connected (phone off) the two backlight test points read about 4 V; with phone on and screen connected about 17 V and 25 V. No 4 V = input coil/diode; unchanged when on = IC not running; low (e.g. 7 V) = output coil.

procedure: Measure test points off (~4 V) and on (~17 V / ~25 V).
Replace coil, diode or LM3539A1 as indicated.

measurements.point: Backlight test points (phone off, battery only)

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.

readings.point: Backlight test points (phone off, battery only)
